title: Template:Cost/doc
wikitext:
;Description :This template is designed to represent the ''most common'' forms of [[currency]]: the set of gold, silver, and copper. :'''All other items that are used as currency, tokens, and quest objectives should use {{t|costitem|cost|actual item|display name/desired link}} instead of this template.'''
  • Base currency *Copper ([[File:Copper.png|16px]]) - ''c'' *Silver ([[File:Silver.png|16px]]) - ''s'' *Gold ([[File:Gold.png|16px]]) - ''g''
;Syntax :{{t|{{BASEPAGENAME}}|gold|silver|copper|g{{=}}|s{{=}}|c{{=}}|ach{{=}}|cs{{=}}|ca{{=}}|dca{{=}}|djt{{=}}|dpt{{=}}|ijt{{=}}|it{{=}}|mwt{{=}}|tbc{{=}}}} ;Example :{{cost|1||30}} :{{cost|2|3}} :{{cost||4|5}} :{{cost|||6}} :{{cost|eob=2}} :{{cost|it=5}} ;Result :{{cost|1||30}} :{{cost|2|3}} :{{cost||4|5}} :{{cost|||6}} :{{cost|eob=2}} :{{cost|it=5}} ==Table usage== For tables that have a column filled with money, the gold, silver, and copper can be manually aligned by using the letter "x". Each "x" is replaced with a space that has the same width as a single digit, acting as a mini indent. If a coin type is filled entirely with x's, that type's icon will additionally be made invisible. ;Example 
{| class="darktable zebra"
! Cost
|-
| {{cost|123|45|67}}
|-
| {{cost|xx1|x2|x3}}
|-
| {{cost|xxx|12}}
|-
| {{cost|xxx|xx|12}}
|}
{| class="darktable zebra" ! Cost |- | {{cost|123|45|67}} |- | {{cost|xx1|x2|x3}} |- | {{cost|xxx|12}} |- | {{cost|xxx|xx|12}} |} ==See also== *{{t|coppercost|amount}} — show an amount of money given as a number copper coins. *{{t|costcopper|g|s|c}} — {{t|cost}}-like syntax to display the copper value of the currency [[Category:WoW currency templates|{{BASEPAGENAME}}]] [[Category:Template documentation|{{BASEPAGENAME}}]]
